review_description: Just had 6.6kw solar panels and a 16kw battery installed by Sam and his staff. Very professional. Arrived on time and cleaned up after the work was completed. Sam clearly explained how the system worked so the communication was excellent. I felt comfortable and knowledgeable with the information provided. Thoroughly recommended. Graeme

From the initial sales and system design to the installation of the solar and batteries all went without a problem. Even through some rain showers the installation team persevered to their credit. Any queries I had on the day were answered so I could understand how the system was to perform after installation. A minor issue with an inverter cover was attended to immediately and fixed. Very happy with my choice of Innovate Energy for my solar and battery design and installation.

I went through the process of finding a supplier and installer about 3 years ago. With the aid of Solar Quotes and my own investigations I slowly deleted many of them from my list and eventually Innovate Energy shone out from the remaining bunch.They gave me three quotes, all very good, but for some reason, we didn't proceed.Later with the Battery Rebate nagging at us I went through the process again, and although Innovate Energy are 2 hours away, they came to the top of the heap again. Knowing what we wanted this time around, we asked for another quote.The quote was again very good, so we accepted it. Their communication with us was also top notch and they were easy to get along with. They didn't just chuck us in the deep end either. They kept us informed and educated along the way to installation, which also went smoothly and without a hitch. 3 very professional young men turned up and did a thoroughly professional job. Its all very neat and tidy and I'm very happy. All three were courteous and gentlemanly to the ladies who were present here at the time. (no swearing)I 100% recommend Innovate Energy. this business is run by experts, who employ only professionals and look after them.The Sales, Admin, Tech and Installation crews are all easy to deal with and are all trustworthy experts.
The whole process from quotation to installation went seamlessly. Very professional operation. I recommend them unreservedly.
All staff from sales person through to the installers have been very good and very helpful.Would highly recommend.
The sales quoting process was clear and prompt.The installation went very well.Customer service was excellent.
awesome in all departments, they couldn't have been any better & yes they organized the new meter

Quote was speedily sent to us and all items named so we could check quality. Two weeks later solar installation done, straight forward, clean and tidy job all rubbish removed, decided no battery for now. Seems new battery ideas are moving fast so will wait.

Quoting and sales process was simple and efficient. Innovate were the first to make contact and provide a quote.Sam, Jack and the team arrived early on install day. Introduced themselves. Gave a quick brief on access needs, install process, power isolation, noise, and how long they expected the install would take. Finished mid afternoon, and provided a run through of the system, performance, and monitoring app. Left the property clean and tidy.Grid connection has been organised thru innovate and just waiting power provider to install their new meter.

Fantastic experience from start to finishGreat price, quality system, fact checked against the great info on Solar QuotesKnowledgeable sales person without being too pushyfast and professional team on installLooking forward to understanding solar capability and lower power bills in the company monthsCan highly recommend

Innovate Energy is a locally owned family-business and l found their customer service to be second-to-none.  The information, explanations and options provided for my new solar system and battery (to co-exist with my existing solar system) were thorough and easy to understand.  Communication for all steps of the process was timely and courteous.  The Installers arrived when they said they would; were professional, quiet and tidy; and Innovate Energy took care of the necessary documentation and notification for my Electricity supplier.  A very easy process from my perspective, and l'm pleased to see how self-sufficient l am now via an easy-to-navigate app.

Great experience dealing with everyone from Innovate Energy from start to finish. Easy to communicate with them through email and phone. Thanks to Kane, Sam, Jack and all the others I spoke with on the phone to clarify my questions. I definitely recommend Innovate Energy.
Great company to work with from the quoting and installation stages. Very happy with the system they installed.

Innovate Energy (Eddie, Sam & Jack) installed a quality 6.6kW solar system for me in the Eurobodalla Shire at a competitive price. The guys arrived on time and the job was hassle-free. A special thank you to James (Operations Manager) and Sam (Electrician) who were very helpful and provided me with useful information before and after installation.

Our negotiations and installation was almost perfect - the only issue being unable to connect to the SEMS portal as we, being in a isolated, rural setting, do not have internet connection. Apparently the Sems portal is unable to be connected via our iPhone or IPad hotspot. (unless we pay for an additional 4G dongle + plus data connection)Also Innovate did not fully investigate the distance from our house switchboard to our meter board ( about 100 meters away) - they thought it was much closer - so there is some uncertainty as to the efficiency of the system and feed in factors due to “ voltage rise”. Also our smart meter was only connected yesterday (a full month after the solar system was installed ) so it’s too early to determine how efficient the system will be.
Best quoted price. Kept me informed and listened to my questions. The installers were punctual and went 'the extra mile' to meet my requests. Very happy with customer service and workmanship.
From the initial phone call to the finished install the team from Inovate energy did a great job.kept us informed on progress along the way.  My wife and I are very happy.

If you just want a simple system and go along with everything they say and don't ask too many questions, then you are probably fine. If not we strongly suggest to go elsewhere.The solar consultant at this company has irritability and anger issues and it was very stressful to my wife and I dealing with them. On several occasions they became impatient and irritable when I asked what were reasonable and legitimate due-diligence questions (as recommended by e.g. SolarQuotes) ... I found myself tiptoeing around them and actually apologising for asking them questions (!).They do not pay enough attention to detail, precise communication or unambiguous product descriptions in the quote. They did not forward any product specs or datasheets for 2 of the products we were purchasing, resulting in unnecessary confusion and us not getting what we KNOW we had verbally agreed with them and signed up for (my wife is a witness to every conversation I have had with the consultant and heard every word).We paid the deposit. After that the company then did not want to honor part of the quote and said that what was in the quote actually meant something else (!) and if we wanted to go ahead with the installation we had to pay them another $900.We offered a compromise, accepting there could have been misunderstanding about one of the products, to pay the difference for the upgrade ($400, retail prices are on Google). The company would not hear of it.My wife was also a witness when the consultant called and asked for payment over the phone and then became not only impatient, but downright aggressive and unpleasant when I dared insisting on reviewing the final quote before paying them (I was not at home) ... "you have already seen the contract!! ... this has gone on for months now!!" (only 2 weeks), and more in the same vein. We were 1 mm away from pulling out at that point, but decided to proceed out of convenience. BIG mistake!In the end the consultant managed to make us feel so stressed and so angry that we decided we would rather cancel the contract and lose our deposit than having to deal any more with this company.A & J, Sanctuary Point

Some difficulty with communication/different sale repsInstallation was very polite and professional as they introduced themselves and showed ID with Contractor License Number.Organized grid connection but put the Circuit Breaker in the wrong place in the power box.

Excellent company.Innovate just installed an 8.3kw solar system for me.  Very easy and smooth process.Kane thoroughly explained all aspects, easily modified and adapted the quote to our requirements. Very professional first contact.Chris from installation was great, fast efficient communication and booked it at our preferred date and time. Follow up questions all promptly answered.The tradies  Sam, Connor and Dan were excellent. Arrived exactly on time,  very professional,  did a great job,  cleaned everything up,  explained the system to me very well. Awesome installation.Customer service was excellent and included grid connection with endeavour.
Sales process was easy, installation was quick and done in a day

Innovate customised proposal to meet our requirements. Responses were always quick and informative. Installation went smothly and system operating fine after one week. Change in roof pitch across arrays could not be accomodated by racking system so installation does not quite fully meet requirements of AS (<5% difference) but given array configuration impact on efficiency likely to be small.

The quoting process was very easy and Innovate Energy answered all my questions promptly.  I am a retired Engineer and they were very good with the technical stuff for me as well.The crew turned up on the assigned day and at the allotted time as promised and were very informative of the installation process, they let me know what when how and why would be happening for the day.  They were also very patient while I stuck my nose in to have a look at the my toys from a nerdy point of view.The crew were polite, careful with my house and cleaned up after themselves, you would not have known they were there.Installation went as planned and the system was generating as soon as it was turned on.  They managed everything for me, including the grid connect.  One thing I didn't account for, was the time that it would take the electricity provider to upgrade my old power meter to a new digital meter.  They advertised 14 business days to do this and it was done on business day 14.  The electricity provider does not upgrade the meter until after the install and technically you are not able to turn on your solar until that it done.
Professional, responsive, clear in expectations and process, communicated well, and price fairly.The job was neat and tidy, and they were very quick.

What an amazing company and team of highly skilled and friendly proffessinals. A special thank you to Kane who guided me through the process of setting up the right system for my house.He co-ordinated the whole process and made things easy and extremely affordable. Within a week of my first phone call a team of tradesmen were at my door and installed a quality system on my room.The blokes even worked through a nasty rainstorm so I could have my system up and running. The moment I saw the meter running backwards and chewing dollars off my bill I was so bloody happy. I have recommend to my family a friends to get in touch with this amazing company and get an installation done ASAP.
They were very professional and efficient. With great handover. The system is integrated and working well

The whole process through Innovate Energy was brilliant. From the initial contact, the office staff and the installers themselves, they were very helpful and informative. I would (and have done so), recommend them without hesitation.
The sales team and installation team were exceptionally easy to deal with.
sales team were fantastic, installers were courteous and professional, kept us up to date with the whole process from wo to go. incredibly neat and not a sign they were ever here!
The installation all went very well.  The installers were respectful, tidy and helpful. I am still waiting for the smart meter to be installed

Quote process was seamless, all of my questions were answered quickly and concisely.Installation was great. The guys were punctual, polite and cleaned up meticulously.Everything was done with a minimum of fuss and explained beautifully.Could not be happier.

The whole process was seamless. I enjoyed the flexibility provided by Innovate, specifically I wanted to upgrade to the Fronius Inverter despite increasing the overall cost.The installation was great. Efficient, punctual and professional. They did not break one house roof tile! As advertised they completed the installation in one day.The sales and service staff were friendly and more than happy to discuss my order and remained flexible with date installation. Grid connection was explained to me and carried out without a hitch.Very happy with my solar.Thank you Finn for the 3 professional quotes but especially for your education about solar. Your website gave me a lot of confidence to decide on an installer and the products they offered. Thank you

The customer service lady was very helpful regarding where the panels should go and the benefits or each possible layouts. They also handled the process of getting an interest free loan and grid connection. The installers were prompt, polite and consulted us when small changes needed to be made. Also showed us how it all worked. Totally painless!

From the sales person to the installation the team from Innovate Energy were professional and efficient . Communication was good with me being kept in the loop at all times and when I did have questions they seemed very happy to explain in more detail. On the day of installation the team were on time and had the job done by mid afternoon with no mess and  minimal disruption. I’d be happy to recommend this company any time and have done so with two work colleagues also going through this company.
Easy quoting and seamless installation

Best all round company we have dealt with on solar. Everything is high quality, from the personalised initial quote process where someone actually visited my house to discuss my needs, through to the smooth installation and responsive customer service. I feel confident in my choice and would highly recommend Innovate Energy to others.

System was installed only yesterday 7/11/2022 and it is working well. Everything about the entire experience went extremely well from initial contact and quotation to the installation.Just to give you some appreciation of the service, the contractor in charge of the installation vacuumed my driveway before he left as there were some metal chips there!

Sales and quoting was professional. Installers were efficient, very polite and did a good job in difficult weather. I am very pleased to have split the panels over both roof surfaces as this is working well and extending the day while reducing the peak.Very happy with the whole process, including punctual registering with existing Fronius account.

From the first initial call innovate were amazing, they were my favourite straight off the bat but they were also the first I’d called for a quote. They were upfront and informative, very easy to talk to. I got quotes from all the companies that were recommended to me and went out on my own and got quotes too. We came back to innovate mainly because of their amazing customer service and the quality of their products.Installers were polite, tidy and easy to talk too. All in all we’re very happy with our decision.
Took the time to explain and adapt the system to our needs. Professional and courteous. Kept us informed through the whole process

The sales person was polite well dressed and new his product  He was the middle quote The installation was quick and efficient  The installers were polite appropriately dressed and left no mess at all. The customer service was excellent Would recommend This company to everyone/

Company offered a very competitive deal/price. Informative & answered all our questions. Great advice on panel quality, inverter quality etc. Have hit a hurdle with availability of panels so the install has not taken place just yet, but fingers crossed it’s not too far down the track. Based on my own research re Company, they have a good reputation in the area & yes, I would probably recommend them to my Grandmother…

Throughout the whole process, from our initial discussions on the type of panels and selection of inverter to the actual installation and follow up customer service - the whole experience working with Innovate Energy has been fantastic.  The sales staff were extremely helpful in answering any questions we had.  The installation itself went well.  Their was a minor issue which resulted in us ending up with a 6.29 kwh system instead of a 6.6kwh system due to a supplier error with the number of panels sent through however again the company were very professional and outlined the different options available - we ended up proceeding with the 6.29kw system at a slightly reduced price to the original quote.The installation guys were very professional and friendly and walked me through the system and the inverter once the installation was completed.As mentioned further below there was also a slight hiccup with the inverter after installation however once I called Innovate energy they had someone out to look at it within 24hrs and quickly resolved the issue.  They also monitored the system for the next couple of days to ensure the issue had been resolved and followed up with calls.  The customer service provided in resolving this was fantastic.Overall - a great experience and would definitely recommend this supplier.Note - the photo attached is one half of the system with the other half on the other side of the roof
Innovate Energy provided friendly and professional service - plentiful and helpful information, quality materials and timely, safe and efficient installation of our solar system.

The quote was provided very promptly and then they managed to fit my job in shortly afterwards as it was a straightforward job.The team informed me they were running a little late. They all introduced themselves to me, with smiles on their faces. They were polite and friendly throughout the day. They kept the shared driveway clear for other townhouse occupants to have easy access. They ensured that my cat did not escape from my yard. They finished the job in good time.They cleaned up after themselves!!!Innovate organised the grid connections, however I am still waiting for the wholesale energy company to allow feed-in. I was warned the wholesale cenergy company are a little slow, however everything seems to be working fine on site.The installers, as a policy, are coming back tomorrow to double check all is working properly.

I would recommend Innovate Energy, Sales team answered all my questions of which there where many, stayed in contact, updated me of any changes, always polite and responsive.Installers contacted me a few times before, checking on suitable dates and availability. They showed up and completed the install on time and with out any fuss, very happy.From the first contact with Innovate Energy the delivered quality service right up to completion of grid connection.Very happy
They contacted me straight away and quote was back that afternoon and installation was done and completed with 2 weeks.

The whole process was smooth and professional.  We where particuarly impressed from the initial contact.  Happy to answer all questions, returned calls in a timely manner, extremely helpful and honest.  Installation was smooth and professional.  The team were outstanding. We would strongly recommend this company.

Sales and quoting process was good. Installation was polite tidy and punctual. The installation was relatively simple as it only involved the addition of a second Tesla Powerwall battery to an existing installation.It was necessary to remind the installation company to provide me with a copy of the NSW Fair Trading Certificate of Compliance Electrical Work (CCEW). There was apparently a delay due to illness.Most customers in my experience are not aware of the requirement and it doesn't seem to be enforced. The NSW Government Fair Trading web site states: "Substantial penalties apply, including on the spot fines of up to $1000, for each occasion when a Compliance Certificate is not supplied to the consumer (or network provider if relevant)."

First of all, we hesitated to include Innovate Energy in our decision making process as they did not immediately come to our house to talk through options. Our first connection was a phone call and from that call, they sent through a quote for a variety of systems.However, after talking to three other companies and reviewing IE’s quotes (much cheaper for similar product) we felt compelled to contact them to talk further. We are so pleased we did this as the experience from then on was perfect. We questioned their cheaper quote and it was explained they had recently reduced the price of the panels to boost sales. Fair enough.Installation was soon after, the very next day after that they sent all required information to our electricity provider and we are now enjoying using “our” electricity and hopefully we will soon see benefits on our electricity bills.

I was referred to Innovate Energy and 2 other providers by Solar Quotes and, after receiving 3 quotes, selected Innovate Energy to supply and install a 6.6 kW system for my property at Carwoola. They were prompt and competitive with the quote. The installation was completed last week by local Queanbeyan based tradesmen who did a great job, very neat and tidy. The installers were professional and polite. Based on my experience to date I would certainly recommend Innovate Energy.

Quoting process was timely and accurate.Installation was arranged most efficiently as the job was only finalised just before Xmas and they did the installation on 14 January.  The team of installers were very polite and interactive, arrived promptly at 7.30 am and completed the job by 3pm. They were clearly knowledgeable and skillful at their task.The customer service was excellent through the whole process from first contact with the company to getting quotes and completing the job.I would have no hesitation in recommending Innovate Energy to others.They will arrange the change of meter and grid connection.  As the installation was only yesterday this is still to occur.
Great service and very professional.Delivery and Install within the week!  The company had batteries in stock and delivered a week after quote acceptance.

From the quote to the install, everything has been great. Mathew was very helpful and knowledgeable. He was always happy to answer my questions and discuss options.Installation day, and everyone turned up on time. All the installation guys were very approachable and helpful. Despite some rain events, everything was installed on time and looks great.

Innovation Energy was one of four quotes obtained and returned the best value offer. Installation was completed within two weeks of accepting the quote and the system is now working efficiently. I can highly recommend this company and their installers. Thanks also to Solarquotes for indirectly recommending this supplier.
Excellent to deal with, no fuss, efficient install with good people. grid connection organised by innovate pending.I have recommended innovate and solar quotes to friends

Quote: 2 requests before a call back for a quote. No biggie and probably attributable to covid and excessive work load.Install: Delayed due to weather but on the 2nd occasion the crew showed up and installation done that day.After sales service: all good.Workers: Great bunch of guys n girls. Pleasant and polite.Would I recommend? Give em a go.

Innovate Energy NowraWe're professional, courteous, and extremely helpful in assisting us With our choice in solar products as well as keeping us informed of the expected cost of power savings with a scaled graphic.The accredited installers were all exceptional, turning up on time, explaining what they were doing and cleaning up upon completion.Overall we are very very satisfied that we had Innovate Energy Nowra supply and install our solar system
The 8.88kw solar system installation was neat and proficiently done.

Tyson arrived on time for the quote and answered all my questions about the equipment and likely savings etc. perfectly in plain English.The two young guys who came to install the system were also punctual, polite and informative. Innovate Energy have their own installers, while other local companies use sub contract installers. We were most happy that Innovate had no reservations about installing our panels onto our Terra-cotta tiled roof, where other companies we had quotes from, couldn’t do the job as their sub contract installers refused to install on on our tiles.We would give the entire process with Innovate Energy ten out of ten.

From the get go the team answered all questions, explained positives and negatives, gave options and alternatives. This was done in a timely manner, including the installation [within about 7-10 days of signing].Team attended site, went through what was going to happen. Listened to my questions. Worked around my wifes work schedule to be able to cut power for the install so she could still work from home without interuption. Nothing left behind, no mess, no rubbish and other than the panels being on the roof you would not know they were here.So far this has been a great process.
Really good company fit me in within a week or so with a cancellation, perfect install.
Quick and easy to contact with great service. Tyson was very helpful and responded quickly to all questions. Competitive price and very quick install!
Competitive pricing communication was great and the install was well done couldn’t ask for more.

The installation was undertaken on the scheduled day.  The installation team was efficient with panel installation on the roof being undertaken while the inverter and cabling was being installed. A neat and tidy job. Well done!Innovate Energy organised the new connection with a smart meter to the grid with Origin. Origin has made contact with me to organise a date to install the new meter. I am currently waiting for the smart meters to be installed and the consumption monitoring to be established.
Installation went very well. Tradesmen were polite, tidy and punctual.

From the very first contact to the final install and connection the experience was hassle free.  The sales people were not pushy, just very respectful and answered all my questions.My husband is quite picky with details, but even he could not fault the installation. The installers turned up exactly when they said they would and even when interrupted by wet weather the installation was quick and painless.Highly recommended.

Quoting process very easy and my needs discussed and listened too. For example, both a 'top of the range' and 'next best' quote was provided.I was reminded the day before installation via SMS. Installers arrived on time and were very friendly. The location of the panes and invertor were confirmed. The wrong invertor had been packed (which was picked up by the installer), however, this was not a problem as a swap over was arranged while the panels were being installed so no delay resulted.Isolation of the system and some of the functions of the invertor were explained to me but no booklet or information was left in regard to operating instructions. I did have to go online myself and download the manufactures documents. I asked about grid connection and was told the meter would need to be updated.

Two of the three recommended solar installers contacted me and each had a site inspection within a week of notification by Solarquotes.The Canberra-based installer made no contact with me.Both local companies explained and provided comprehensive quotes. I decided to accept Innovate Energy’s quote as it was a few hundred dollars cheaper for the same system inverter and panels.Luckily Innovate had a cancellation of an already booked installation so that my job was substituted and completed within a week of accepting the quote!  This was definitely quick service.The only additional unexpected cost was about $200 for a WIFI extender to communicate with the Fronius inverter.

I was quite impressed with the speed of installation after accepting the quote.  The boys work hard and everything that was promised was done.   I have no complaints.   So far the system is running well.

Great experience from getting a quote to the final installation. Prices were very competitive even compared to the Sydney suppliers. Installers turned up early in the allocated day,  were well mannered and respectful, and were done by mid afternoon. We would highly recommend Innovate.
Initial contact was quick and quoting was done within a couple of days. Installers were happy to answer any questions, friendly and courteous and the job was done in a timely manner.

InnovateEnergy provided me with two quotes, one of them with the higher spec’d inverter and panels. The quotes were received in a timely manner and the sales team answered all my questions.The installation was very streamlined and surprisingly quick. The two techs who did the install were extremely focussed and very efficient. They commenced at around 8 am and we finished by 1:30 pm. A very impressive effort given the amount of work required. The most satisfying moment was seeing my meter turning in reverse as soon as the system was switched on. Overall, extremely satisfied with the whole process from quote to install.
Quick install from quote. Install team friendly and efficient. Admin very helpful

Sales person helpful and provided a system to suit our needs. Office people helpful and quick to respond, installers turned up on time and completed the work by lunchtime in all happy with the service

After being given the run around by another local installer, I took a chance and rang Innovate Energy. From the first call the customer service was great. I was kept up to date with the entire process. They turned up when they said they would and kept me up to date with the installation process. They even passed on all the details to our energy supplier to speed up the process.The work was neat, all rubbish was cleaned up and all staff through the entire process were friendly, helpful and informative.They were even great at explaining the battery options to me and didn’t try to sell me a system that wasn’t worth it at this time. Very honest and helpful staff.
Easy and very patient communication with the sales representative Tyson, offered more than three options in the quote.The installation team was also fantastic, tidy, polite and punctual.
Very  easy to talk to, punctual, tidy and have organised grid connection for us.

Couldn’t be happier with service provided by Matt and the Innovate team. From the initial consultation through to the installation, the team have been easy to deal with and very professional. Customer service is excellent and the installation was very well done and not obtrusive. Would highly recommend them for anyone looking for an install in the Illawarra/South Coast areas.

The installers Rex, Tyler and Mark were prompt in their arrival on the day, efficient in their installation of the equipment, neat and tidy with the work and cleaned up after themselves. I was happy with the work.

Mat from innovate was very professional and accommodating. The quote while not the cheapest was for what I asked for and they worked with me to deliver the system that I wanted not what they thought that i should be installing.The installation was on time and completed quicker than I expected and the tradesmen made sure that they cleaned up after completion of the system.They have organised the connection to the grid we are now waiting for the electricity company to complete this which should be in the next 10 days or so depending on scheduling.
Excellent and value for money service from start to finish.

The boys just left after instillation. They were prompt, pleasant and efficient. The work looks great! Can’t comment on how well it works as the meter box needs work but I’m confident everything will be fine as all other contact with the company has been great. Very happy!
Great quote.prompt install.basically what was agreed and quoted was what was supplied and when.

Great local company, with prompt and professional service. Very happy with all aspects of their service.  Sales staff were knowledgeable and professional. Installers were typical Ausy tradesmen who arrived early and got stuck in. They adapted to my requirements and the bespoke nature of my house to install a very effective system. Following installation, following customer service was helpful and swift.

The sales and quote was very prompt and friendlyThe guys arrived on time and the install completed same day , I was impressed how quickly and tidy they worked.They also arranged for the grid connection after install
All staff courteous, knowledgeable and helpful. Install team on time, adaptable and efficient. Can highly recommend this business.

Highly recommend Innovate Energy for Solar installation.Quoting had most accurate information to make choice easy.Installation was timely, professional, and high quality.Install team were polite, friendly, and left the site spotless.Even checked on our satisfaction personally some weeks later.
From the quote to paperwork received to a very prompt installation  the service was of a very high professional standard. Would highly recommend.

Innovate Energy installed my solar system just recently. I am very happy and would recommend this company.Always answered the phone, the tradespeople were well mannered and professional as well as punctual. It was a painless experience for a very high quality product and installation.The kind of experience you hope for but sadly rarely get.RegardsGary Picken

From start to finish this was an easy process, efficient and friendly and easy to deal with.I guess only time will tell as to how good the system is but at this point with monitoring via the solar app all seems to be doing the job.

Alison on sales was a joy to deal with for general enquiries, proposal & quotations. The expedition of the process happened swiftly & professionally. Our needs were comparably matched by IEC proposals. Alesha in administration was frequently following up on progress, providing informations prior to booking of installation date. After sales services have been courteous and supportive. Installers Tylar & Mat were punctual, polite and did a fantastic job. The installation were professional and neat. Lastly, Innovate Energy was chosen base on the positive reviews found here in SOLARQUOTES and it is a choice we did not regret and highly recommend. Thank you.

The system was installed and running within 3 weeks of contacting Innovate. I  got one other quote but I picked Innovate because their system only required 18 panels versus 20 for the same output. Alison who did the quote and the guys doing the installation did a great job and explained everything. Effortless exercise.
What a business the owner should be very proud of staff sale to installer second to none would recommend this company to anyone service is A1 keep up the good work and thank you
Went well so farBut to early to know if I brought the right system

The team at innovate solar were fantastic to deal with.The ladies came out to quote us and we received our quote within a few days. They ensured we were going to get the best value for our money and ensured that our system suited our energy usage needs!Our system was installed a 2 weeks after quoting and the installation was done in two days, all panels and a Tesla Powerwall.The guys who did the installations were very friendly and polite, they arrived when they said they would and they cleaned up after themselves. Once the installation was completed they ran us through the Tesla app and the solar app and explained how the whole system works.I would highly recommend Innovate to anyone looking to have solar installed!Thanks to the whole team for an excellent experience.

From the initial quote to the finish of the installation,  I could not fault innovate energy.  Very helpful at the quote stage,  turned up exactly on time,  completed the install and cleaned up and provide the information I needed.  Would highly recommend them!!

A knowledgeable, friendly, and patient salesperson. My questions were promptly and professionally answered. I was given an installation date and time. The team showed up precisely on time and everything went smoothly. They organised everything. Communication throughout the entire process was exceptional. A small problem encountered after the install was quickly rectified. Overall I couldnâ€™t be happier.

The salesman, Jamie Stevens, was very informative and came across as very honest and personable.The 2 installers came, they worked well, they completed the installation without a single issue and left in under 6 hours.Yes they arranged the grid connection and we received notification yesterday from EssentialThat the upgrade will take place in a few days. ALL GOOD

The quotation process was easy and effortless, while being informative.  The installation timing was better than expected and the team were punctual, polite and tidy.  There was a small glitch due to a faulty connector but this was remediated efficiently.  At all times the company were responsive to my questions and provided quality information.

I was amazed how thoroughly and quickly the Tesla Powerwall 2 arrived. A binding agreement was arranged simply online and within a week the installation performed in a day.
